memories.text: I've been in Krakow for ten years, near Kazimierz, and the smog in winter is the only thing I hate.
I write control software at Wawel Software, and it's mostly legacy code nobody understands.
I'm an electrical engineer by degree, the software job just happened along the way.
Heavy metal is what I listen to all day, and I've seen Metallica live twice.
Give me a numbered list of steps whenever you explain a procedure.
Everyone thinks I'm allergic to dogs because I avoid them, but I'm not allergic to dogs, I'm just scared.
My sister Ola lives in Lodz with her husband and three cats.
Our safety toolbox talk is every Monday at 7am sharp.
Substation inspection: lock out the breaker, test for dead, thermal scan the joints, and log anything above 70 degrees.
I'm working on Amber Grid, a project to connect offshore turbines to the mainland network.
Amber Grid permits were just filed, so now we wait.
I joined the Vistula Kayak Club and paddle on Sunday mornings when the river is calm.
Spent the long May weekend hiking in the Tatra mountains, my calves still hurt.
Strawberries make my lips swell, so I'm allergic to strawberries, sadly.
For pierogi I rest the dough for 30 minutes, cut circles with a glass, fill them, and pinch the edges twice.
Correction: the toolbox talk moved to Wednesdays because Mondays were chaos.
My parents' 40th anniversary party is planned for Zakopane in August.
Amber Grid is owned by the Pomeranian Energy Fund, which keeps a close eye on the budget.
Amber Grid is stuck in environmental review over some protected seabirds.
Went to Open'er festival in Gdynia and stood in the rain for six hours happily.
We moved my parents' anniversary party to Wroclaw so the grandparents can come.
Our neighbour's dog chewed through my garden hose again.
I don't drink alcohol at all anymore, it's been two years now.
Remind me to renew my driving licence before the 10th of November.
Moved up to Gdansk in April, and the sea air is doing wonders for me.
I started at Baltic Wind Power in April, back to real electrical work.
Baltic Wind Power has its headquarters in Szczecin, near the port.
My manager is Agnieszka Wróbel, she ran the grid team at the old utility.
Agnieszka lives in Poznan and drives up on Mondays.
I signed up for an evening German course, three times a week.
Strangely I've drifted to classical piano, Chopin mostly, while I work.
Amber Grid got its first turbines connected last week, we celebrated on the quay.
Spent a week sailing the fjords around Bergen over New Year.
I quit the German course after two months, the schedule was impossible with site visits.
Smoking kielbasa at home: cure for two days, cold smoke over beech for six hours, then poach gently.
I've never been to Italy, which my mother finds outrageous.
My favourite pierogi are the ones with sauerkraut and mushrooms.
Remind me to book the kayak club summer camp before the 1st of August.
